# 1UP Barbershop

> Barbershop in Shaenfield, San Antonio, TX. Precision fades, tapers, beard
> grooming, lineups, kids cuts and loc maintenance. Walk-ins welcome,
> appointments available, open seven days a week.

- Address: 7807 W Loop 1604 N, San Antonio, TX 78254
- Phone: (210) 708-2580
- Hours: Mon-Fri 10:00-19:00, Sat 10:00-17:00, Sun 11:00-17:00 (America/Chicago)
- Walk-ins: welcome every day the shop is open
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/up1barbershop/
